scoring_justification: Headline DS energies and band gaps are recomputed from the agent's raw ds_energies.csv; segment means and standard deviations are compared to paper gold with tolerances. Alignment and H‑bond lifetimes are compared to paper references.

outputs.description: Time series of defect state energy above VBM and VBM-CBM gap for each snapshot. Checker will compute segment-wise means and standard deviations and compare to hidden paper reference values with tolerance.
Segment-wise summary statistics of defect state energy and band gap. Checker compares directly to hidden reference values with tolerance.
Aligned VBM and defect state energy on the electrochemical scale. Checker compares values to hidden paper reference with tolerance.

Hydrogen bond survival times and exponential fit R² for different surface and bond types. Checker verifies that R² exceeds a threshold and that tau values are within tolerance of hidden paper reference.

output_contract.notes: The primary verification is recomputation of summary statistics from ds_energies.csv and comparison to reference values; ds_summary.csv is a convenience artifact that may also be checked directly. Alignment values are checked against paper-derived references. Hydrogen bond survival R² must meet a minimum threshold (fits of sufficient quality), and tau values are compared within tolerance.

steps.description: Recompute segment‑wise mean / std of DS energy above VBM and VBM‑CBM gap from raw time series; compare to paper gold within tolerances. Also check snapshot counts per segment.
Validate existence and required columns of ds_summary.csv (near‑zero weight).
Compare aligned VBM, DS mean, DS std, and offset from OER to paper reference with tolerance.
Compare tau_ps to gold with relative tolerance 20% and check r_squared >= 0.9 for each row; average across the six surface/bond types.
